newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Geneva airport Jan-Nov 96 cargo traffic down 6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Geneva airport Jan-Nov 96 cargo traffic down 6 pct.

text.p: Geneva's Cointrin airport handled 5,473 tonnes of air cargo traffic in November 1996, a decrease of 6.1 percent on the same month in 1995, airport authority figures show.
January-November 1996 air cargo throughput at Geneva totalled 58,837 tonnes, down seven percent on 1995 levels.
Swissair operates a twice-weekly full-freighter service between Geneva and Singapore, with stopovers at Dubai and Madras, using a 67-tonne capacity McDonnell Douglas DC-10-30F.
The Swiss airline also operates a weekly DC-10F service between Geneva and Sao Paulo.

November 1996 postal traffic fell by 2.4 percent on the same month in 1995 to 769 tonnes while January-November 1996 volume fell by 1.8 percent on the first 11 months of the previous year to 7,993 tonnes.
